 This app is nothing more than an invoice creator or custom estimate tool. Can do the same with any other free app that is properly advertised as a simple invoice/estimate tool. Do not fall for the lies in this company’s false advertising. And yes I did get the premium version to see and possibly use all of the features. reviews.text:
Scammer Alert !. At first, the app worked perfectly and did exactly what it was supposed to do. Because of that, I decided to subscribe to the Premium plan to access all features.

However, after a recent update, the app stopped working properly on my phone. The preview function no longer works and only shows a template instead of the actual invoice. The only way to use it properly is by logging in online, which defeats the purpose of having the app.

I contacted support immediately. They acknowledged the issue and said it would be escalated to their engineering team. That was on February 6, and since then we’ve been going back and forth. As of today, May 1, the issue is still not resolved.

I understand that updates can sometimes cause problems, but taking 3 months without a fix is unacceptable especially for a paid Premium subscription. On top of that, there has been no compensation or solution offered for the time I’ve been unable to use the app properly.

Very disappointing experience.
